features.name: Live order books
features.description: Keeps Binance's BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT order books from the live streams and logs top of book and every resync.
features.inputs: Binance USD-M depth and aggTrades streams (network)
features.outputs: top-of-book and resync lines on stdout

features.name: Record a live run
features.description: Records every live input to a new run in the data dir until Ctrl-C.
features.inputs: Binance USD-M depth and aggTrades streams (network)
features.outputs: <data dir>/market/<run_id>/ with manifest.json and the binary log

features.name: Engine API server
features.description: Runs the live feed, or a recorded script, behind the local HTTP and WebSocket API on 127.0.0.1.
features.inputs: Binance live streams, or a JSON-lines script with --script; --record also records the feed
features.outputs: the local API (book and trade messages, Arrow streams); with --record a run in the data dir

features.name: Recover a crashed run
features.description: Closes a crashed run's newest log segment, cutting a torn tail back to the last good frame.
features.command: cargo run --release -p engine --bin store -- recover <run dir>
features.inputs: a run folder whose newest segment was left open
features.outputs: the segment closed in place; damage in the middle is refused

features.name: Rotate a run into Parquet
features.description: Writes Parquet for every closed log segment of a run; safe to re-run.
features.command: cargo run --release -p engine --bin store -- rotate <run dir>
features.inputs: a run folder with closed log segments
features.outputs: frames, depth_updates, trades, snapshots and book_samples Parquet per segment

features.name: Replay a run
features.description: Rebuilds a run's books from its log or its Parquet and prints what it rebuilt.
features.command: cargo run --release -p engine --bin store -- replay <run dir> --parquet
features.inputs: a run folder (log, or Parquet with --parquet)
features.outputs: a summary of the rebuilt books on stdout

features.name: Import an archive day
features.description: Turns one downloaded Bybit order-book or Binance aggTrades archive day into a run.
features.inputs: <date>_<SYMBOL>_ob200.data.zip or <SYMBOL>-aggTrades-<date>.zip; optional --seed with the day before's closing book
features.outputs: <data dir>/market/<yyyymmdd>T000000Z-<venue>-<symbol>/ with Parquet, manifest.json and complete.json

features.name: Record a session for the replay check
features.description: Records a live session with the live loop's transcript, then replays the log and says whether it matched.
features.inputs: Binance live streams (network)
features.outputs: a run and live-transcript.json under harness/fixtures/recorded/ (gitignored), and the replay verdict

features.name: Soak report
features.description: Runs the live pipeline for hours and reports gaps, resyncs, reconnects and dropped frames per period.
features.inputs: Binance live streams (network)
features.outputs: one line per period on stdout and in a file under harness/out/

features.name: Ising staircase run
features.description: Runs a quasi-static sweep down the temperature grid, with each dwell set by a pilot's tau.json.
features.inputs: a lattice size and a pilot's tau.json
features.outputs: <data dir>/ising/<run_id>/ with manifest, configurations and statistics

features.name: Ising cooling ramp
features.description: Runs a linear cooling ramp at a Kibble-Zurek point of a pilot record's tau_c, or at an explicit rate.
features.inputs: a lattice size, --x with a pilot record, or --rate
features.outputs: <data dir>/ising/<run_id>/

features.name: Ising null run
features.description: Runs a fixed-temperature null run above Tc at epsilon_L of 2, 4 or 6.
features.inputs: a lattice size, epsilon_L and a pilot record that measured that size
features.outputs: <data dir>/ising/<run_id>/

features.name: Ising pilot
features.description: Measures the integrated autocorrelation time of |m| and the energy at given temperatures.
features.inputs: a lattice size and temperatures
features.outputs: a run folder with tau.json

features.name: Ising tau_c fit
features.description: Fits tau_c(L) at Tc and A L^z from pilot runs, one per size.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ising tauc <run dir> <run dir>
features.inputs: pilot run folders at Tc
features.outputs: pilot.json

features.name: Ising simulator validation
features.description: Checks a small L = 4 run against exact results and exits 1 on a failure.
features.inputs: none
features.outputs: a run folder with the gate verdicts; exit code

features.name: Resume an Ising run
features.description: Continues a crashed or stopped simulator run from its checkpoint.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ising resume <run dir>
features.inputs: a run folder with a checkpoint
features.outputs: the same run folder, completed

features.name: Surrogate-test calibration
features.description: Measures the surrogate test's false-positive rate on synthetic nulls and exits 1 off the band.
features.inputs: none (synthetic nulls from a seed)
features.outputs: the false-positive rate on stdout; exit code

features.name: Score a pre-registration
features.description: Scores the runs a frozen pre-registration names and logs every evaluated cell as a trial.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ews score --prereg paper/prereg/ising-ews-v1.toml
features.inputs: a frozen pre-registration and the runs it pins in the data dir
features.outputs: <data dir>/ews/<run_id>/ and lines in <data dir>/ews/trials.jsonl

features.name: Freeze a pre-registration
features.description: Tags the commit that holds paper/prereg/<id>-v<k>.toml as prereg/<id>-v<k>.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.ews prereg freeze <id>
features.inputs: a committed pre-registration file
features.outputs: a git tag

features.name: Train a JEPA
features.description: Trains one model seed on the staircase runs of dedicated simulator seeds.
features.inputs: simulator staircase runs and a pilot record
features.outputs: <data dir>/jepa/<run_id>/ with checkpoints and monitors

features.name: Resume a JEPA training
features.description: Continues a training from its checkpoint after a crash or a killed session.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa resume <run dir>
features.inputs: a training folder with a checkpoint
features.outputs: the same training folder, completed

features.name: Extract latents
features.description: Writes a checkpoint's latents table (surprise, pc_1..pc_8 per frame) for a simulator run.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa extract <checkpoint> <run dir>
features.inputs: a checkpoint and a simulator run
features.outputs: <run>/latents/<training>-step<step>/

features.name: Probe a training
features.description: Fits ridge probes of |m|, energy and L^2 Var(|m|) from frozen embeddings, trained beside the untrained twin.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa probe <training dir> --fit <run dir>
features.inputs: a training folder and simulator runs to fit and test on
features.outputs: probe scores with their controls on stdout, or as JSON with --json

features.name: Verify finished folders
features.description: Checks trainings, latents tables and simulator runs against their complete.json and exits 1 on any problem.
features.inputs: finished folders
features.outputs: one verdict per folder; exit code

features.name: GPU budget
features.description: Sums GPU hours per ISO week from the training log against a weekly quota.
features.inputs: <data dir>/jepa/gpu_hours.jsonl
features.outputs: hours per week on stdout

features.name: Fetch Binance archives
features.description: Downloads and verifies Binance's 1-minute klines, 5-minute metrics and monthly funding for a span of days.
features.inputs: a span of UTC days and symbols (network)
features.outputs: verified files under <data dir>/archives/binance or --dest

features.name: Regime labels
features.description: Labels volatility regimes for a span of days from the fetched files.
features.inputs: fetched Binance files; --prereg for the confirmatory span
features.outputs: <data dir>/labels/<run_id>/

features.name: Cascade candidates
features.description: Lists liquidation-cascade candidates for a span of days from the fetched files.
features.inputs: fetched Binance files; --prereg for the confirmatory span
features.outputs: <data dir>/labels/<run_id>/ holding the cascades table

features.name: Labels reports
features.description: Writes the reports of a labels run, optionally against a cascade run.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.market reports --run <labels run>
features.inputs: a labels run, the fetched files, optionally a cascade run
features.outputs: reports in the labels run's reports/ folder

features.name: Panel coins
features.description: Derives the 30-coin panel of Binance USDT perpetuals from Binance Vision and checks it against the committed list.
features.inputs: Binance Vision's bucket listing and monthly 1-day klines (network)
features.outputs: the ranking on stdout; exit 1 when it differs from panel/coins.txt

features.name: Panel fetch
features.description: Downloads and verifies the panel's 1-minute klines, 5-minute metrics and monthly funding in parallel.
features.inputs: the committed panel and a span of UTC days before 2024 (network)
features.outputs: verified files under <data dir>/archives/binance or --dest

features.name: Panel labels
features.description: Writes the panel's per-coin cascade thresholds, its cascades and an hourly label grid from the fetched files.
features.inputs: fetched Binance files of the panel
features.outputs: <data dir>/labels/<run_id>/ holding the thresholds, cascades and grid tables

features.name: Panel inputs
features.description: Writes the model inputs of every coin and UTC hour of a panel labels run's grid, own-coin and market means.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel inputs --labels <run id>
features.inputs: a panel labels run and the fetched Binance files of the panel
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-inputs/<run_id>/ holding the inputs table

features.name: Panel ladder
features.description: Fits and scores nested sets of panel inputs out of fold by calendar quarter and compares them with a joint block bootstrap, from a plan file.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel ladder --inputs <run id>
features.inputs: a panel inputs run, its labels run and a plan file (default panel/ladder.toml)
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-ladder/<run_id>/ holding out-of-fold scores, scores, folds, comparisons, row accounting and report.md

features.name: Panel sequence models
features.description: Trains a JEPA, its untrained twin and a supervised model on the last 336 hours of a ladder rung's panel inputs inside each quarter fold, probes the JEPA's and twin's readouts over a grid of readouts and penalties on the ladder's common rows, and saves every fitted model, from a plan file; panel/sequence-final.toml fits every model once on the development span's hours more than the gap before its end and scores nothing.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel sequence --inputs <run id>
features.inputs: a panel inputs run, its labels run and a plan file (default panel/sequence.toml, which names its ladder plan)
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-sequence/<run_id>/ holding diagnostics, loss curves, the per-fold AUC table, row accounting, report.md and the saved models under encoders/

features.name: Panel sequence scores
features.description: Writes the out-of-fold scores of one model and variant of a sequence run from its saved models, choosing the JEPA's or twin's readout and penalty from the run's per-fold AUC table by the selection rule, for a ladder plan's external entry.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel scores --sequence <run id> --model <jepa|twin|supervised> --variant <variant>
features.inputs: a panel sequence run, its inputs run and its labels run
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-scores/<run_id>/ holding one Parquet table per scheme with the columns coin, hour, horizon, side, score, fold and scheme

features.name: Panel sequence merge
features.description: Joins sequence runs that split a parent plan (by default the shipped one) into one run that the scores command reads, after checking that their plans differ from the parent only in variants, seeds and folds, that they fitted every cell of the parent once and no other, and that they read the same inputs, labels grid and ladder plan and ran the same code, library versions, CPU capability and instruction-set pins.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel merge --runs <run id> <run id> ... --plan <sequence.toml>
features.inputs: two or more completed panel sequence runs
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-sequence/<run_id>/ holding the merged diagnostics, curves, folds and rows tables, report.md, the parent plan and every saved model, with the source runs, their manifests' sha256 and their CPU models in the manifest

features.name: Panel classical comparators
features.description: Fits the ladder's rungs over the sequence plan's penalty grid and a logistic on plain statistics of the 336-hour window a sequence model reads, on the sequence probes' folds, rows and scales, chooses one configuration per rung and variant by the sequence models' selection rule (or takes a fixed one) and exports its out-of-fold scores for a ladder plan's external entry.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel classical --inputs <run id>
features.inputs: a panel inputs run, its labels run and a sequence plan file (default panel/sequence.toml, which names its ladder plan)
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-classical/<run_id>/ holding the per-fold AUC table, row accounting, report.md, both plans and one Parquet table per exported name and scheme with the columns coin, hour, horizon, side, score, fold and scheme

features.name: Panel paired comparison
features.description: Scores the exported out-of-fold score files of a comparison plan's arms as pairs on the ladder's rows with the ladder's own block-bootstrap draws, adds a paired long+short row per pair and the same statistics on draws that lose no quarter, marks one pair primary, and refuses any arm that does not come, by committed code and on-disk hashes, from the inputs run, labels grid and ladder plan of the comparison or that differs from a configuration the plan pins.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.panel compare --inputs <run id> --arm <name>=<run id> ... [--unbound]
features.inputs: a panel inputs run, its labels run, one panel scores or panel classical run per arm and a comparison plan (default panel/compare.toml, which names its ladder plan)
features.outputs: <data dir>/panel-compare/<run_id>/ holding the scores, folds, comparisons and rows tables, report.md led by the primary row, both plans, and each arm's provenance in the manifest

features.name: Panel forward check
features.description: Says, reading no cascade label, whether a sequence run's trained JEPA embeddings carry next-day information about the inputs that their untrained twins do not, also beyond the input row at the same hour, and whether they keep the inputs, from ridge probes on every forward fold and seed, with two rules on vol_24h and oi_24h.
features.command: uv run python harness/panel_forward.py --sequence <sequence run folder> --inputs <inputs run folder> --out <new folder outside the repo>
features.inputs: a panel sequence run with its saved models, its inputs run and the ts_ns and symbol columns of its labels grid
features.outputs: <out>/ holding forward.parquet, report.md ending with both rules, and manifest.json with the sha256 of every file read

features.name: Book feature range
features.description: Imports and reduces the Bybit order-book days of a range into per-day feature files.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.market book --range training
features.inputs: Bybit archive days (network) and the engine's store binary
features.outputs: <out>/<range>/manifest.json and features/<SYMBOL>/<day>.parquet

features.name: Reduce one book day
features.description: Reduces one day's book_samples Parquet to its feature file and prints the file's record as JSON.
features.inputs: an engine run's book_samples Parquet
features.outputs: <out>/features/<SYMBOL>/<day>.parquet and one JSON line

features.name: Gate
features.description: Runs every Rust and Python check, judges each from its own evidence and writes a record.
features.inputs: the checkout; cargo on PATH
features.outputs: one verdict per leg and a record under harness/out/; exit code

features.name: Kill stray processes
features.description: Finds and kills engine and harness processes that a killed test run left running.
features.inputs: the running processes
features.outputs: the strays found, and killed unless --dry-run

features.name: Assemble book ranges
features.description: Merges market book range folders made on separate machines into one data dir, refusing any gap or duplicate.
features.inputs: range folders from market book
features.outputs: <out>/<range>/manifest.json and the copied feature files

features.name: ising-ews-v1 figure
features.description: Draws the README's figure of the ising-ews-v1 result from its result folder.
features.command: uv run --with matplotlib==3.10.3 python harness/ews_v1_figure.py <result dir> paper/figures/ising-ews-v1.png
features.inputs: the result folder's fss, peaks and auc tables
features.outputs: a PNG

features.name: ising-ews-v1 golden
features.description: Writes what the v1 scorer gives on planted data, so a later commit can be held to it.
features.inputs: the planted v1 dataset and paper/prereg/ising-ews-v1.toml
features.outputs: the golden file

features.name: Latent experiment
features.description: Runs a frozen latent pre-registration from its file to the result folder and its figures.
features.inputs: a frozen latent pre-registration, the runs and latents tables it pins
features.outputs: <data dir>/ews/<run_id>/ with tables, csv/ and figures/

features.name: Latent scoring data dir
features.description: Assembles the data dir a latent pre-registration is scored from: its runs, latents tables and checkpoints hard linked from Kaggle outputs and data dirs, each checked against its complete.json, with ews/ linked to the data dir whose trial log counts the budget.
features.command: uv run python harness/latent_data_dir.py --prereg <file> --from <folder> --into <new data dir>
features.inputs: a latent pre-registration and data-dir-shaped folders holding its runs, latents tables and trainings
features.outputs: <into>/ising/, <into>/jepa/ and the link <into>/ews

features.name: Latent experiment figures
features.description: Draws a latent experiment's figures from its csv tables alone.
features.command: uv run --isolated --no-project --with matplotlib==3.10.3 python harness/ising_figures.py <result dir>
features.inputs: a result folder's csv/ tables
features.outputs: five PNGs in figures/

features.name: Market JEPA pilot training
features.description: Runs one of the four market JEPA CPU pilot trainings.
features.command: uv run python harness/m4_pilot.py train --asset btc --size S --data <dir> --out <dir>
features.inputs: an assembled book feature data dir
features.outputs: a training folder with checkpoints

features.name: Market JEPA pilot decision
features.description: Applies the pilot's committed rules to the four finished pilots.
features.inputs: the four finished pilot trainings
features.outputs: the decided size, steps and floors as JSON

features.name: Market JEPA primary training
features.description: Trains one market JEPA primary or spare seed.
features.command: uv run python harness/m8_primaries.py train --asset btc --seed 101 --data <dir> --out <dir>
features.inputs: an assembled book feature data dir
features.outputs: a training folder with checkpoints and its step-0 twin

features.name: Market JEPA primary pins
features.description: Writes the pins of the finished primaries before any extraction.
features.inputs: the finished primary trainings
features.outputs: <out>/pins.json

features.name: Market latent gate
features.description: Writes the gate record that opens the confirmatory span: a market-latent file frozen at its prereg tag, a clean tree, and checkpoints equal to the pins.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa.market_extract gate --prereg paper/prereg/market-latent-v1.toml --pins <pins.json> --out <gate.json>
features.inputs: the frozen market-latent file and pins.json
features.outputs: <gate.json>

features.name: Market latent units
features.description: Reads the pinned checkpoints and their step-0 twins over a span in units of checkpoint x symbol x block of days, one shard at a time, resuming after a kill.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa.market_extract run --pins <pins.json> --primaries <dir> --data <bybit-book-v4> --span exploratory --out <dir>
features.inputs: pins.json, the primary trainings, the book feature days, and a gate record for the confirmatory span
features.outputs: <out>/units/<run id>-step<step>/<symbol>-<span>/<first day>.parquet and .json

features.name: Market latent merge
features.description: Checks every unit of a span and joins them into one per-minute series per checkpoint and symbol.
features.command: uv run python -m tipping_point.jepa.market_extract merge --units <dir> --span exploratory --pins <pins.json> --out <dir>
features.inputs: unit folders, from one or several machines, and pins.json
features.outputs: <out>/<run id>-step<step>/<symbol>-<span>.parquet and .json

features.name: Verify market latent files
features.description: Checks every market latent unit or series against the sha256 its record names and exits 1 on any problem.
features.inputs: unit or series folders
features.outputs: one line per problem; exit code

features.name: Exploratory market indicators
features.description: Shows the classic market warning indicators on the 2023 pilot year, logging no trial.
features.inputs: a labels run of the frozen labels file and the fetched Binance files
features.outputs: AUC tables on stdout

features.name: Circularity floor
features.description: Runs GARCH paths through a labels run's own labeller and scores them, as a report.
features.command: uv run python harness/market_floor.py --run <labels run> --garch BTCUSDT
features.inputs: a labels run and a GARCH fit
features.outputs: a floor report in the run's reports/ folder

features.name: GARCH fit
features.description: Fits the circularity floor's GARCH(1,1)-t on the 2023 pilot year.
features.inputs: a labels run and the fetched Binance klines
features.outputs: the garch report in the run's reports/ folder

features.name: Wheel provenance check
features.description: Checks end to end that runs from a built wheel record the commit stamped into it.
features.inputs: this checkout, or a wheel with --wheel
features.outputs: a verdict per case on stdout; exit code

features.name: Join a Kaggle output to the local runs
features.description: Makes a data dir that links a Kaggle output's latents tables beside the local runs they were read from, refusing a table read from other bytes.
features.command: uv run --no-sync python harness/explore join_pilot --output <kaggle out> --into <folder>
features.inputs: the local data dir (--local) and a Kaggle output's out/ folder
features.outputs: <into>/ising/<run id>/ with hard links to each run's files, its latents tables and the tau_c records

features.name: Exploratory latent pass
features.description: Runs every exploratory step for one training, its trained table beside its untrained twin, at each size; logs no trial and refuses the scored seeds.
features.command: uv run --no-sync python harness/explore latent_pass --training <run id> --step <step> --data-dir <folder> --out <outputs>
features.inputs: a data dir with the seeds 1-5 simulator runs and the training's latents tables
features.outputs: each step's JSON and report.md per table and size, and latent-report-<training>.md, under --out

features.name: Exploratory values at Tc
features.description: Computes one size's values at Tc and its equilibrium curves against eps_L from the staircases, on |m| or a latents table.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 staircases and the pilot run held at Tc in the data dir; --latents <table> for a table
features.outputs: static.json and static-draws.npz under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Exploratory scaling table
features.description: Takes the slope of each quantity at Tc on log L over the sizes given, from static_tc's outputs.
features.inputs: static_tc's outputs at each size
features.outputs: scaling.json and scaling.md under <out>/<classic or table>/

features.name: Exploratory AUC
features.description: Computes the AUC of slow ramps against fixed-T nulls for every sensitivity cell and horizon, and the scorer's alarm rows at the headline cell.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 slow ramps and null runs in the data dir; --latents <table> for a table's four pairs
features.outputs: auc_alarms.json under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Exploratory peak positions
features.description: Finds where each indicator peaks along each slow ramp at one size, or with --combine tests the positions over sizes.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 slow ramps; --combine reads each size's peaks.json
features.outputs: peaks.json under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/; peaks-combined.json under <out>/<classic or table>/ with --combine

features.name: Exploratory null runs
features.description: Shows the indicators and their trend scores on the fixed-T null runs alone, per eps_L and pooled.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 null runs at eps_L 2, 4 and 6
features.outputs: nulls.json under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Exploratory surrogate calibration
features.description: Scores each real null slice and slow-ramp positive against its own surrogates and reports the false-positive and detection rates.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 null runs and slow ramps; with --latents, surprise's directions
features.outputs: surrogates-<observable>-<indicator>-<kind>.json per pair and kind under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Exploratory alarm threshold
features.description: Reads what an alarm-threshold rule can do on the null runs' s(t) paths: the highest false-alarm rate, and each rule's theta and first alarms.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 null runs and slow ramps; with --latents, surprise's directions
features.outputs: alarms_explore-<observable>-<indicator>.json and cached st-*.npz under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Exploratory ramp ensembles
features.description: Computes ensemble indicators along the fast and slow ramps and the Kibble-Zurek lag behind the staircase curve.
features.inputs: the seeds 1-5 ramps and static_tc's static.json
features.outputs: fast_ramps.json under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Exploratory fixed-eps slopes
features.description: Sets the slopes over two sizes at fixed eps_L from the null runs, the staircases and the slow ramps beside the slopes at Tc.
features.inputs: nulls.json, static.json and fast_ramps.json at both sizes, and scaling.json
features.outputs: fixed-eps-<column>.json under <out>/<classic or table>/

features.name: Exploratory size report
features.description: Writes one size's exploratory JSON outputs as markdown tables.
features.inputs: the JSON the other steps wrote for that size
features.outputs: report.md under <out>/<classic or table>/L<L>/

features.name: Market latent series
features.description: Writes each market JEPA checkpoint's per-minute surprise and pc series for one symbol and span, refusing any day from 2024.
features.command: uv run --no-sync python harness/explore market_latents --checkpoints <a.pt> --symbol ETHUSDT --scaling-run <training> --data <bybit-book-v3> --out <folder>
features.inputs: market JEPA checkpoints, a training on the symbol for its scaling record, and the assembled book feature days
features.outputs: <out>/<run id>-step<step>/<symbol>-<span>.parquet and .json

features.name: Market exploratory pass
features.description: Scores market_latents' 2023-Q4 series on event and control segments and proposes each pair's direction and the columns to judge.
features.command: uv run --no-sync python harness/explore market_pass --latents <market_latents out> --labels <labels run>
features.inputs: market_latents' output folder and a labels run
features.outputs: market-pass.json, market-proposal.json and market-report.md in <latents>/pass, or --out

features.name: Exploratory latent plot
features.description: Draws surprise and pc_1 against eps_L for a checkpoint and its twin from the pass's JSON.
features.inputs: the exploratory pass's JSON
features.outputs: <out>/latent-curves-<training>.png

features.name: Exploratory scaling plot
features.description: Draws the static scaling plot from scaling.json.
features.inputs: scaling.json from the exploratory pass
features.outputs: a PNG beside the JSON

features.name: Kaggle plan runner
features.description: Embeds a plan of simulator runs and JEPA trainings in a Kaggle kernel, or checks a plan without running it.
features.inputs: a plan JSON
features.outputs: a kernel folder with --write-kernel; the checked plan with --dry-run

features.name: Panel sequence Kaggle kernels
features.description: Writes the panel sequence run as twelve Kaggle CPU kernels, one variant, one seed and three folds each, the final plan's fit-only fold as six more, one variant and one seed each, plus a dry-run kernel on a synthetic panel, every kernel pinned to one commit.
features.command: uv run python notebooks/kaggle_panel_sequence.py write --commit <40 hex> --out <dir>
features.inputs: a pushed commit
features.outputs: nineteen kernel folders that kaggle kernels push takes

internal.command: uv run --no-sync python notebooks/kaggle_panel_sequence.py local-dry <empty dir>
